title: After waiting…, before taking…
summary: Причастные обороты после союзов и предлогов (after, before, while, since, on, by, without, once, when): формы -ing, having + V3, being + V3, правило одного подлежащего и опущение подлежащего с be.
ru:
## Что это за конструкция
После некоторых союзов и предлогов вместо полного придаточного можно поставить **причастный оборот** без подлежащего: **After waiting** for an hour, we left. = After we had waited for an hour, we left. Так речь становится компактнее и книжнее. Чаще всего используются **after, before, while, since, on, by, without**, а также **when, once, until, although**.
> **Before signing** the contract, read it carefully. — Прежде чем подписывать договор, внимательно прочитайте его.
> **While waiting** for the train, I read an article. — Пока ждал поезд, я читал статью.
> **Since moving** to Oslo, he has learned Norwegian. — С тех пор как переехал в Осло, он выучил норвежский.

## Правило одного подлежащего
Подлежащее причастного оборота — **то же, что в главной части**. Если подлежащие разные, получается нелепая «висящая» конструкция (dangling participle):
- ~~After finishing the exam, the room was silent.~~ (получается, что комната закончила экзамен)
- → After finishing the exam, **the students** left the room.
- ~~When opening the file, the system crashed.~~ → When **I** opened the file, the system crashed. (или: **Opening** the file, **I** saw the system crash.)

## Три формы
- **-ing** — действие одновременно или без акцента на порядок: *While walking to work, I met an old friend.*
- **having + V3** — действие завершено **до** главного, подчёркивает порядок: *After having checked all the figures, the auditor signed the report.* Обычно после **after** допустима и простая форма -ing; **before** с having почти не используют.
- **being + V3 / having been + V3** — пассив: *After being told about the delay, the passengers complained.* — После того как пассажирам сообщили о задержке...

## on + -ing, by + -ing, without + -ing
- **On + -ing** = «сразу после того как», формально: *On hearing the alarm, he ran outside.*
- **By + -ing** = «посредством»: *By working overtime, she finished early.*
- **Without + -ing** = «не сделав»: *He left without saying a word.* — Если нужен пассив: **without being asked**.

## Опущение подлежащего и be после союза
После **when, while, once, until, if, unless, although** можно опустить **подлежащее + be**, если подлежащее то же, что в главной части:
> **When (it is) heated**, the metal expands. — При нагревании металл расширяется.
> **Once (it has been) opened**, the jar should be kept in the fridge. — После вскрытия банку хранят в холодильнике.
> **Although (he was) exhausted**, he finished the marathon.
> **While (she was) washing up**, Anna listened to the radio.
Само подлежащее, если оно другое, опускать нельзя: ~~Once opening, the form should be returned~~ → Once **completed**, the form should be returned.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Before to sign the contract~~ → Before **signing**.
- ~~After finished the work~~ → After **finishing** / After **having finished** the work.
- ~~Walking down the street, a bird landed on my shoulder.~~ → Walking down the street, **I felt** a bird land on my shoulder.
- ~~On asked about the budget~~ → On **being asked** about the budget.
en:
## What is this structure?
After some conjunctions and prepositions we can use a **participle clause** with no subject instead of a full clause: **After waiting** for an hour, we left. = After we had waited for an hour, we left. The result is shorter and more formal. It is most common after **after, before, while, since, on, by, without**, and also **when, once, until, although**.
> **Before signing** the contract, read it carefully.
> **While waiting** for the train, I read an article.
> **Since moving** to Oslo, he has learned Norwegian.

## The same-subject rule
The subject of the participle clause must be **the same as the subject of the main clause**. If not, we get a dangling participle:
- ~~After finishing the exam, the room was silent.~~ (the room did not finish the exam)
- → After finishing the exam, **the students** left the room.
- ~~When opening the file, the system crashed.~~ → When **I** opened the file, the system crashed.

## Three forms
- **-ing**: simultaneous or when order is not important: *While walking to work, I met an old friend.*
- **having + past participle**: the action was completed **before** the main one: *After having checked all the figures, the auditor signed the report.* After **after** a simple -ing form is usually enough; **before having** is rare.
- **being + past participle / having been + past participle**: passive: *After being told about the delay, the passengers complained.*

## on + -ing, by + -ing, without + -ing
- **On + -ing** = immediately after, formal: *On hearing the alarm, he ran outside.*
- **By + -ing** = by means of: *By working overtime, she finished early.*
- **Without + -ing**: *He left without saying a word.* For the passive: **without being asked**.

## Leaving out subject + be after a conjunction
After **when, while, once, until, if, unless, although** you can omit **subject + be** when the subject is the same as in the main clause:
> **When (it is) heated**, the metal expands.
> **Once (it has been) opened**, the jar should be kept in the fridge.
> **Although (he was) exhausted**, he finished the marathon.
> **While (she was) washing up**, Anna listened to the radio.
If the subject is different you cannot omit it. ~~Once completing, the form should be returned~~ → Once **completed**, the form should be returned.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Before to sign the contract~~ → Before **signing**
- ~~After finished the work~~ → After **finishing** / **having finished**
- ~~Walking down the street, a bird landed on my shoulder.~~ → Walking down the street, **I felt** a bird land on my shoulder.
- ~~On asked about the budget~~ → On **being asked**
structure:
## Формы
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| after / before / while / since + V-ing | то же подлежащее, одновременно или по порядку | Before leaving, check the windows. |
| after + having + V3 | действие завершено раньше | After having read it, she called. |
| after + being / having been + V3 | пассив | After being interviewed, she waited. |
| on + V-ing | сразу после | On arriving, call me. |
| by + V-ing | способ | By saving, he bought a car. |
| without + V-ing / being + V3 | не сделав | without being asked |

## Опущение подлежащего + be
| Полная форма | Сокращённая |
|---|---|
| When it is heated, ... | When heated, ... |
| Once it has been opened, ... | Once opened, ... |
| Although he was tired, ... | Although tired, ... |
| While she was washing up, ... | While washing up, ... |
| Unless it is stated otherwise, ... | Unless stated otherwise, ... |

## Формула
> **Conjunction / preposition** + V-ing, + главная часть (то же подлежащее)
> **After having** + V3, ... ·  **Before** + V-ing, ...

## Запомните
- Подлежащее совпадает с подлежащим главной части.
- ~~Before to sign~~ → Before **signing**: после предлога только -ing.

exercises.title: Причастные обороты
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в скобках в нужной форме (если допустимо несколько форм — достаточно одной).
exercises.example: After (finish) the report, she emailed it. → **finishing**

items.text: After {{finishing|having finished}} the report, she emailed it to the director.
Before {{signing}} the contract, read it carefully.
{{While|Whilst}} waiting for the train, I read an article.
On {{arriving}} at the hotel, we discovered that the booking had been lost.
Since {{moving|having moved}} to Oslo, he has learned Norwegian.
He left the meeting without {{saying}} a word.
After {{being told|having been told}} about the delay, the passengers complained.

exercises.title: Ещё обороты
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово или форму глагола.

items.text: {{Once|When}} opened, the jar must be kept in the fridge.
Although {{tired|exhausted}}, she kept working until midnight.
He injured his knee {{while|when}} playing football.
By {{working}} overtime, she finished the project early.
{{After}} having checked all the figures, the auditor signed off.
Before {{leaving}} the office, please switch off the lights.
Since {{being|having been}} promoted, she has been travelling a lot.
Without {{being}} asked, he cleaned the whole kitchen.

items.q: ___ the room, she turned off the light.
After ___ the results, the team celebrated.
While ___ to work, I met an old friend.
Having ___ the instructions, he started the engine.
items.why: Having + V3: сначала прочёл, потом завёл.

items.q: After ___ by the manager, the applicants were shown the office.
Since ___ the firm, he has earned more.
items.why: После since в этой конструкции — **joining** (то же подлежащее he).

exercises.title: Найдите верное предложение
exercises.instruction: Только одно предложение правильное. Следите за подлежащим.

options: Walking down the street, a bird landed on my shoulder.
Walking down the street, I felt a bird land on my shoulder.
Walking down the street, a bird's landing on my shoulder.
items.why: Подлежащее оборота (кто шёл) должно быть подлежащим главной части: I.

options: After finishing the exam, the room was silent.
After finishing the exam, the students left the room.
After finishing the exam, the room emptied.
items.why: Экзамен закончили студенты, а не комната.

options: On being asked about the budget, the minister refused to comment.
On asked about the budget, the minister refused to comment.
On ask about the budget, the minister refused to comment.
items.why: После on нужна форма -ing; здесь пассив — being asked.

options: When opening the file, the system crashed.
When I opened the file, the system crashed.
When opening the file, a crash occurred.
items.why: Опускать подлежащее можно, только если оно совпадает с подлежащим главной части; здесь система ≠ тот, кто открывал.

options: Having been warned, he took an umbrella.
Having warned, he took an umbrella.
Been warned, he took an umbrella.
items.why: Он сам получил предупреждение — пассив **having been warned**.

options: Before to sign the contract, read it.
Before signing the contract, read it.
Before sign the contract, read it.
Once completed, the form should be returned to reception.
Once completing, the form should be returned to reception.
Once complete it, the form should be returned to reception.
items.why: Сокращённое «once it is completed» — **once completed** (причастие прошедшего времени, пассив).

exercises.title: Сократите придаточные
exercises.instruction: Замените придаточное причастным оборотом, используя слова в скобках.

items.prompt: After she had read the email, she called the client. (After ...)
answers: After reading the email, she called the client.
After having read the email, she called the client.
After reading the email she called the client.
After having read the email she called the client.

items.prompt: Before he left the house, he checked the windows. (Before ...)
answers: Before leaving the house, he checked the windows.
Before leaving the house he checked the windows.

items.prompt: While she was travelling in Peru, she learned some Quechua. (While ...)
answers: While travelling in Peru, she learned some Quechua.
While traveling in Peru, she learned some Quechua.
Whilst travelling in Peru, she learned some Quechua.
While travelling in Peru she learned some Quechua.
While traveling in Peru she learned some Quechua.
Whilst travelling in Peru she learned some Quechua.

items.prompt: As soon as he heard the alarm, he ran outside. (On ...)
answers: On hearing the alarm, he ran outside.
On hearing the alarm he ran outside.

items.prompt: Since I started the course, I have met many interesting people. (Since ...)
answers: Since starting the course, I have met many interesting people.
Since starting the course, I've met many interesting people.
Since starting the course I have met many interesting people.
Since starting the course I've met many interesting people.

items.prompt: After she had been interviewed, she was offered the job. (After ...)
answers: After being interviewed, she was offered the job.
After having been interviewed, she was offered the job.
After being interviewed she was offered the job.
After having been interviewed she was offered the job.

exercises.title: Ещё сокращения
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение короче, опустив подлежащее и be.

items.prompt: When you are using this machine, wear gloves. (When ...)
answers: When using this machine, wear gloves.
When using this machine wear gloves.

items.prompt: Although he was exhausted, he finished the marathon. (Although ...)
answers: Although exhausted, he finished the marathon.
Although exhausted he finished the marathon.

items.prompt: Once it has been opened, the milk should be kept cold. (Once ...)
answers: Once opened, the milk should be kept cold.
Once opened the milk should be kept cold.

items.prompt: While she was washing up, Anna listened to the radio. (While ...)
answers: While washing up, Anna listened to the radio.
While washing the dishes, Anna listened to the radio.
While washing up Anna listened to the radio.
While washing the dishes Anna listened to the radio.

items.prompt: She had checked all the figures. Then she signed the report. (Having ...)
answers: Having checked all the figures, she signed the report.
Having checked all the figures she signed the report.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя причастные обороты.

items.prompt: What do you usually do before leaving home in the morning? (Before leaving ...)
items.sample: Before leaving home, I always check that I have my keys and my phone.

items.prompt: What do you do while waiting for something (a bus, a meeting)? (While waiting ...)
items.sample: While waiting for the bus, I usually listen to a podcast.

items.prompt: Say what you did after finishing an important task (After finishing / After having finished ...).
items.sample: After finishing my exams, I slept for almost twelve hours.

items.prompt: Describe a change since a certain moment in your life (Since moving / Since starting ...).
items.sample: Since starting my new job, I have been going to bed much earlier.
